_meta.description: Simulated SMS inbox and call log for the Oct 19-22 replay. iPhone apps can't read real SMS, so the Streamlit app feeds these in on the simulated clock. Messages marked 'persona' are taken from the screenshots; the rest are filler so the inbox looks realistically noisy.
